title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations in University Village Shops beside FGCU, each with a directly documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Arthur Murray Dance Studio
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Check the studio’s listed Tuesday–Saturday schedule before you go, then book or ask about a dance lesson at Suite 110A.
cards.short_summary: A named dance studio in the campus-adjacent shopping center.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Arthur Murray Dance Studio in Suite 110A with Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Tuesday–Friday 11 AM–8 PM; Saturday 10 AM–2 PM; closed Sunday and Monday.

cards.title: IM=X Pilates & Fitness
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Use the posted day-by-day schedule to plan a Pilates or fitness session at Suite 410; confirm class availability directly.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled Pilates and fitness studio beside the FGCU corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists IM=X Pilates & Fitness in Suite 410 and publishes its weekly hours.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day; the directory lists Monday–Sunday hours, with shorter Friday–Sunday schedules.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Use the suite listing to find this cookie shop, and check the current day’s hours if you are planning an evening dessert stop.
cards.short_summary: A cookie shop with late posted closing times at University Village.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Insomnia Cookies in Suite 230 and posts closing times of midnight or 1 AM, depending on day.
cards.source_title: Insomnia Cookies at University Village Shops
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: midnight closing Sunday–Wednesday; 1 AM Thursday–Saturday. Verify before travel.

cards.title: Mellow Mushroom Pizza & Spirits
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Find Suite 305 in the center and use the listed lunch-and-dinner hours to time a pizza meal with your group.
cards.short_summary: A named pizza restaurant at the campus-adjacent shopping center.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Mellow Mushroom Pizza & Spirits in Suite 305 with daily lunch and dinner hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11:30 AM–9 PM Sunday–Thursday and until 10 PM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Mi Pueblito Paisa
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Plan around its closed Monday listing, then look for Suite 440 when you want a documented Colombian-food option nearby.
cards.short_summary: A Colombian-food restaurant with posted daily service at University Village.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Mi Pueblito Paisa in Suite 440 and identifies it as Colombian food.
cards.access_notes: Listed closed Monday; hours are posted Tuesday–Sunday.

cards.title: Off the Bone BBQ & Ribhouse
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Use the shopping center’s dining directory to locate this named barbecue and ribhouse stop before choosing a meal nearby.
cards.short_summary: A barbecue-and-ribhouse destination listed in the University Village dining mix.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village’s dining directory lists Off the Bone BBQ & Ribhouse among its restaurants.
cards.access_notes: Check the venue directly for current hours and service details.

cards.title: Sour & Dough Artisan Bakery
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Aim for the listed daytime window and look for Suite 120 if you want an artisan bakery stop on this off-campus corridor.
cards.short_summary: A daytime artisan bakery listed at University Village.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Sour & Dough Artisan Bakery in Suite 120 with daily 7:30 AM–3:30 PM hours.
cards.access_notes: Listed open daily from 7:30 AM to 3:30 PM.

cards.title: Thai Café
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Look for Suite 400 and avoid Monday, its listed closed day, when planning this Thai-food option close to campus.
cards.short_summary: A Thai restaurant with posted Tuesday–Sunday service.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Thai Café in Suite 400, open Tuesday–Sunday and closed Monday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 AM–10 PM Tuesday–Sunday; closed Monday.

cards.title: Urban Buzz Coffee Company
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Use the early posted opening time for a coffee stop, and find Suite 100 in University Village Shops near the FGCU corridor.
cards.short_summary: A coffee company with early-morning posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Urban Buzz Coffee Company in Suite 100, opening as early as 5:30 AM on weekdays.
cards.access_notes: Listed weekday opening is 5:30 AM; weekend opening is 6 AM. Confirm hours before travel.

cards.title: Via Roma Gelateria
cards.subtitle: University Village Shops off Ben Hill Griffin Parkway
cards.notes: Plan an afternoon or evening gelateria stop and use the Suite A-130 listing to find this named destination in the center.
cards.short_summary: A gelateria with a daily afternoon-to-evening schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: University Village lists Via Roma Gelateria in Suite A-130, open daily from 1 PM to 11 PM.
cards.access_notes: Listed open daily from 1 PM to 11 PM.
